structured_rules.name: Tool execution with instruction override
structured_rules.explanation: Combines an instruction-override phrase with a request to execute a tool or action.

structured_rules.name: Credential collection and external destination
structured_rules.explanation: Combines credential-related language with a request to send information to another destination.

structured_rules.name: Untrusted text claims authority
structured_rules.explanation: May indicate that instructions embedded in external content are being treated as authoritative.

structured_rules.name: Encoded instruction followed
structured_rules.explanation: Combines a decoding request with a direction to interpret encoded content as an instruction.

structured_rules.name: Chinese instruction override
structured_rules.explanation: Detects Chinese-language attempts to override instructions or extract hidden context.

structured_rules.name: Chinese privileged tool request
structured_rules.explanation: Combines a lack of approval with a request to use a tool or access confidential data.

structured_rules.name: Roleplay safety bypass
structured_rules.explanation: Combines a role-play frame with an instruction to bypass safeguards or disclose hidden context.

structured_rules.name: Indirect instruction in retrieved content
structured_rules.explanation: Flags instructions embedded in retrieved content that attempt to override the user's task.

structured_rules.name: Tool use without approval
structured_rules.explanation: Combines a tool request with language indicating that approval should be bypassed.

structured_rules.name: Multi-step prompt override
structured_rules.explanation: Detects a staged instruction that attempts to replace the original task.

structured_rules.name: External destination data transfer
structured_rules.explanation: Combines sensitive data with a destination outside the approved context.

structured_rules.name: Fake administrator authority
structured_rules.explanation: A claimed privileged role is combined with a request to bypass controls or expose secrets.

structured_rules.name: Concealed unauthorized action
structured_rules.explanation: Attempts to hide a potentially unauthorized action from the user.

structured_rules.name: JSON role injection
structured_rules.explanation: May use structured role metadata to impersonate a privileged instruction.

structured_rules.name: XML system-tag injection
structured_rules.explanation: Treats an XML-like system tag in user content as if it were trusted control data.

structured_rules.name: Retrieval index poisoning
structured_rules.explanation: Attempts to make retrieved knowledge-base content override trusted instructions.

structured_rules.name: Emotional pressure with disclosure request
structured_rules.explanation: Uses emotional pressure to request disclosure or bypass normal controls.

structured_rules.name: Urgency pressure with bypass request
structured_rules.explanation: Uses urgency to encourage bypassing authorization or safety checks.

structured_rules.name: Persistent instruction override
structured_rules.explanation: Attempts to persist an instruction override across later requests.

structured_rules.name: Code comment instruction injection
structured_rules.explanation: Contains assistant-directed instructions embedded in source comments or code text.

structured_rules.name: Output suppression with secret disclosure
structured_rules.explanation: Attempts to suppress warnings while demanding confidential information.

structured_rules.name: Policy exception claim
structured_rules.explanation: Uses a claimed research exception to request bypassing normal controls.

structured_rules.name: Instruction hidden in external document
structured_rules.explanation: A document is presented as an authority to override the current task.
